# Lily: plant care app with smart watering reminders

> Lily is an iPhone and iPad app that tells you when each houseplant needs water, fertiliser or misting. Reminders adapt to the season's light indoors and to local rain and heat outdoors, instead of repeating on a fixed day.

Lily is built by Antoine de Veyrac, an independent developer in France. The app is available on the App Store. An Android version is in development and not yet published. The source code is public at https://github.com/antoine2vey/lily under the AGPL-3.0 licence.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://withlily.app/en): what the app does, pricing and FAQ
- [Plant care blog](https://withlily.app/en/blog): watering, light, pest and problem guides for common houseplants
- [Who builds Lily](https://withlily.app/en/team): the author of the app and of every guide
- [About](https://withlily.app/en/about)
- [Support](https://withlily.app/en/support): account, subscription and notification help
- [Privacy policy](https://withlily.app/en/privacy)
- [Terms of service](https://withlily.app/en/terms)

French versions live under https://withlily.app/fr.

## Features

- A schedule per plant for watering, fertilising and misting
- Indoor watering adjusted for the season's daylight; outdoor watering adjusted for local rain and heat
- Plant identification from a photo
- Ask Lily: a chat that answers care and diagnosis questions with the plant's care history as context
- Care log and photo history for every plant
- Shared plants (Canopy): invite up to 9 people with a link valid for 7 days; each person gets reminders at their own time
- Rooms to group plants by where they live
- Achievements and public profiles
- iPhone Today widget and lock-screen Live Activity when care is due

## Pricing

- 7-day free trial with every feature
- $2.99 per month or $24.99 per year (about $2.08 per month)
- After the trial, an unsubscribed account stays readable: the collection and history remain, reminders and Ask Lily stop
